verdict.rationale: Reclaim is a scheduling SaaS, so exposing availability, bookings and event types to external agents through an MCP server or tool-calling API is a fair axis. The evidence shows only an in-app AI Assistant, Google/Outlook add-ons and Slack integrations, with no MCP server or public tool-calling surface. The OpenAPI probes returned 404, and the llms.txt file is a help-center docs index, not an agent tool interface.
